facts.descriptionEnglish: A steamed soup-dumpling specialty from Nanxiang in Jiading, traditionally made with a thin wrapper, minced pork, and jellied pork skin.
A seasonal spring soup combining salted pork, fresh pork, and bamboo shoots in a light-colored broth.
A classic Shanghai duck dish stuffed with ingredients such as glutinous rice, chestnuts, and mushrooms, then slowly braised.
A Shanghai dish of lightly stir-fried shrimp known for a translucent appearance and a soft yet crisp texture.
A traditional Shanghai noodle dish tossed with fragrant oil made by slowly cooking scallions until golden and crisp.
